text:
Nina: Quick report — on small viewports (~320360px) the console list compresses and the action chevron becomes unreachable; when the left rail hides we get a weird vertical snap. GIF: https://redwood-internal.screens/gifs/rail-snap.gif

Omar: Thanks. Is the snap during the collapse animation or after it finishes?

Nina: During the animation. The row height flickers (looks like repaint + layout thrash). Also on Android Chrome the last row gets a 4px cutoff.

Priya: Probable causes: 1) 100vh CSS assumptions, 2) fixed header + dynamic address bar, 3) body scroll locking toggles changing overflow which triggers reflow.

Lucas: For the action chevron being unreachable: we might be hiding it under the mobile bottom bar. Could we shrink the table row padding at <360px? Or move actions into an overflow menu that anchors to the row and portals to body?

Nina: Shrinking padding helps but feels hacky. I like the portal idea for the menu so it can layer above overlays. That also solves z-index issues when the rail is open as overlay.

Omar: If we portal, ensure positioning uses fixed with a transform offset rather than absolute, otherwise x/y will break on scroll. Also avoid transform on the parent to prevent stacking context traps.

Priya: Accessibility: when we switch to overlay mode the menu and the rail should both have aria-modal semantics if active. And we need a visible focus ring for the condensed toggle. Screen reader should announce "menu expanded" vs "menu collapsed".

Lucas: UX question: should the left rail become an overlay at <= 420px or should we collapse earlier and show only icons at <= 480px? My concern: on narrow tablets icon-only rail still gives useful nav without an overlay, but on tiny phones overlay is better.

Nina: Proposal: two-step behavior: 480px -> icon-only; 420px -> overlay. That avoids sudden width jumps on some android devices.

Omar: Works for me. Engineering caveat: icons-only requires a different hit target size for touch; we should keep 44px min touch target and increase vertical spacing.

Priya: Copy nit: toggle tooltip should read "Open navigation" on small screens. "Collapse" is ambiguous. Also add "Double-tap to expand" on accessible docs? Might confuse people. Keep it simple: "Open navigation" / "Close navigation".

Lucas: I'm going to prototype portal-based popover with fixed positioning + body-scroll-lock and no parent transforms. I'll also add a small shim to apply padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom) to the list container.

Nina: Nice. Can you add a toggle in the design sandbox to test 3 breakpoint states (>=480, 420-479, <420)? I want to QA layout shifts on several device UA widths.

design-bot: Added sandbox variants (480, 440, 360) and linked visual diff job. Tags: mobile-responsive, ux, a11y.
